description:
Hushfeed v0.15.0 targets global TikTok 46.2.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

This is the first release under the project's own name. The bundle, the entry in TikTok's settings and the settings screen say Hushfeed, and the about row links to the project page.

Since v0.14.0: the block button targets the video on screen instead of the one prefetched next, the creator's country can sit beside their name, classified videos play without the warning overlay, the caption, music line, action column, survey cards and status bar each got a switch, a long press can do nothing or open the comments, and the settings screen follows the phone's language with English and German shipped.

Settings backups now carry the hushfeed-settings tag. Older backups and undo copies still restore.

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key. Behaviour that needs a person on the phone is listed in the project's blocked roadmap.

Validation: 149 runtime tests passed. The bundle contains 61 patches and passed the checks for all three DEX payloads. Every patch with a new fingerprint was applied to the real 46.2.3 APK with the desktop CLI.
